mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates a severe labor market contraction that signals economic distress, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate combined with declining consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a dual stress in the labor market and consumption, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The interaction between UNRATE and RSAFS does not produce a significant negative signal (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return pattern is reversed in more than 55% of interaction events.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession housing recovery (HOUST > 600 thousand units), elevated consumer spending (RSAFS) supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 600, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 220, it signals accelerating inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A strong housing market (HOUST > 600) combined with robust industrial production (INDPRO > 101) indicates broad-based economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition HOUST>600 and INDPRO>101 does not produce positive returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) falls below 50 thousand jobs per month, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS < 50, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
